title: Contribute here — the specific threads, checked 30 September; #38 and #58 assigned to Contexts v2, PR #12 fifth commit pushed, four replies posted, the Round 2 opener held
lead: 30 September: PR #12 took its fifth commit (1fe332e: the 023/024 review fold, the PCS source pinned, the v2 rulings carried). Posted on the gate: AY (cred-spec #9, close it), AX (the inline reply on PR #11, record 023), AV (#58), AW (#38). Held: AP, the Round 2 opener, until its date is set. cred-spec is at Working Draft 0.6.0. Still unanswered: TF PR #28, trust-tasks-tf #544. Earlier state follows. Nothing of ours moved upstream since 23 September: spec PR #11 (3 commits, Denys Popov's inline review of 007 recorded), PR #12 (4 commits, Round 2) and TF PR #28 (guide) are open, green and unreviewed. Beside us the week was loud: cred-spec decided its context IRI and froze `v1` (#48; registry PR #7 open), adopted `issuerScope` (#46), a REQUIRED `salt` = record 022 option 1 (#38, `v2` timing), and the Trust Tasks editor answered our #58 with a detached citation that supersedes record 008 route 1 (bmiller59 +1; geoffturk awaited). trust-tasks-tf shipped the five hidden-vetting tasks record 024 needs (#618/#620) and framework 0.7.0; OpenVTC opened a public `predicate-credential-system` repository (README only). vti-setup closed our two issues (links PR #42 merged; the guard PR #43 closed — they dropped the release flow instead); VTI #1651/#1652 were closed by the maintainer. Records 008, 022 and 024 are amended locally on the Round 2 branch (uncommitted). Ready: AV (#58). Refreshed: AP (Round 2 opener; date = Mitch). Held: AW (#38).

lines.title: One controller, many identifiers
lines.claim: Linkage is proven, never read out of a field; equality of hidden values is a different relation from common control.

lines.title: Evidence is not a decision
lines.claim: An authenticated statement about a procedure is not the relation a proof establishes, and neither is the admission decision.

lines.title: Bind exactly what you mean
lines.claim: A transcript binds a byte-exact predicate identifier and a pinned accept-list revision; nothing is substituted afterwards.

lines.title: Authority is a chain, delegation is a chain, and they are not the same chain
lines.claim: act ∈ scope_n ⊆ … ⊆ scope_root with bounded depth and per-link status; attenuation is the authority-side sibling.

lines.title: Continuity survives a key
lines.claim: A relationship proof outlives the key that first bound it, through an attested rotation, without the counterparty re-vouching.
